testo:
■ Revolution Change: Armored that costs 3 or more or Mecha that costs 3 or more. (Whenever the specified creature attacks, you may switch that creature with this creature from your hand.)
Blocker
Double Breaker
■ When you put this creature with "Revolution Change", your opponent can't cast spells that cost 5 or less until the start of your next turn.
■ At the end of each of your turns, untap this creature.

Blocker
Double Breaker
■ このクリーチャーが「革命チェンジ」によって出た時、次の自分のターンのはじめまで、相手はコスト５以下の呪文を唱えられない。
